statements.text: I, of course, share the same concerns of many members of this Committee, that we must be thoughtful in our approach, and that the opportunities that come with AI, also come with a variety of risks. [...] My question is for Ms. Mote. Your testimony mentions a common concern about AI, that if not used properly may negatively impact students' social, emotional development.
statements.context: Opening remarks and question during a House Education and Workforce Subcommittee hearing on AI in K-12 education.

statements.text: Data centers need to pay their own way, and siting decisions must be transparent, locally driven, and centered on the people who live in these communities. It's wrong to hand out tax breaks and public resources to data centers, especially while cutting over $1 trillion in food assistance, Medicaid, and health care.
statements.venue: Press release on cosponsoring the Reverse Big Ugly Tax Breaks for Data Centers Act

statements.text: We need to lower gas prices and home energy costs…we also have major concerns around data centers and AI…we have to restore accountability around DHS and ICE…we need serious anticorruption legislation…a ban on trading stock…pardoning reform,
statements.venue: Post-election press conference, reported by WAER
